# Advokat Pengacara Luthfi Asshiddieqy

> Law office of Luthfi Asshiddieqy, S.H., a licensed Indonesian advocate (advokat / pengacara). Bar number (NIA) 17.01703, member of PERADI (Perhimpunan Advokat Indonesia). Based in Purbalingga, Central Java, and serving the Banyumas Raya area: Purbalingga, Banjarnegara, Purwokerto, Banyumas, and Cilacap. The first consultation is free.

The website is bilingual. Indonesian is the primary language; an English version is available through the language switch on each page.

## Practice areas
- Marriage and divorce (Perkawinan & Perceraian)
- Inheritance (Waris)
- Land law (Pertanahan)
- General civil law (Perdata)

## Main pages
- [Home]({{ site.url }}/): the firm, its practice areas, and the service region.

- [Journal]({{ site.url }}/blog/): legal articles and practical guides.
- [Terms of Use]({{ site.url }}/terms/): website terms.
